item.title: Adam Savage Steps Inside Lucasfilm’s Legendary STAR WARS Art Department
item.description: Geek icon Adam Savage recently got an up-close look at one of the most legendary creative spaces in Hollywood with a visit to Lucasfilm’s Star Wars art department, and it’s exactly the kind of deep-dive that makes fans grin. During the visit, which was posted on Tested, Savage spent time with Doug Chiang, the visionary concept designer George Lucas tapped when he returned to Star Wars to create the Prequel Trilogy, tasking Chiang with reshaping the galaxy far, far away while honoring its roots.

item.title: LEGO and Crocs Just Dropped Wearable Brick Clogs
item.description: If you’ve ever looked at a LEGO brick and thought, yeah I’d rock that as footwear, you’re in luck. They’re made from the same comfy Crocs material fans already love, complete with a LEGO stud design across the top and LEGO-stamped straps that sell the whole brick-on-your-feet look.
